scene: The glowing brass globe clicks open, revealing intricate clockwork gears.
picture: First-person close-up view of the opened hollow globe filling the frame. The curved brass rim borders the view. Inside, intricate interlocking copper gears tick softly. Up high, a tiny ruby lever gleams. At centre, a numbered gold dial is fixed into the clockwork. On the right, a curled parchment roll rests in a bracket.
shown: a tiny red ruby lever sitting up high inside the sphere
a numbered gold dial mounted at centre among the brass gears
a tightly tied parchment scroll tucked into a slot on the right

variants.scene: The heavy brass ring unlatches, exposing a humming nest of intricate clockwork.
Polished cogs tick softly inside, framing an ornate dial and a rolled scroll.
